_note: Hand-authored site identity — NOT written by the fetchers. The canonical positioning line is written once here and build.py feeds it to every site-level surface (title, meta description, og/twitter description, home masthead tagline, footer, subscribe form). Edit it here and nowhere else.
name: NoCashFlow

positioning.en: Macro, markets and finance engineering — written by a finance engineer, sourced from primary data.
positioning.tr: Makro, piyasalar ve finance engineering — bir finance engineer tarafından, birincil kaynaklardan.

analytics._note: Cloudflare Web Analytics, JS beacon flavour — the site is served straight from GitHub Pages and is not proxied through Cloudflare, so the edge cannot inject it. Paste the token from Cloudflare dashboard → Web Analytics → Add a site → nocashflow.net. While token is empty NO beacon is emitted and the privacy policy says the site uses no analytics; both switch on together the moment it is filled in.
